No separate Russia vehicle, fund name or manager was found. The firm's own page (bvcapital.com/about-us, Common Crawl, Feb 2012) says the Otto-anchored European fund eVenture Fund I covers Russia and Ukraine, and its team page lists the Moscow analyst (Alexandra Rasskazova) and a Kiev analyst (Ekaterina Mikula) as staff of eVenture Capital Partners, the Hamburg manager of that fund. Deal pages name the same manager: Sapato.ru 2010-11 ('eVenture Capital Partners'), Mapia.ua 2009 ('Hamburg based investment house eVentures Capital Partners'), Wine in Black and Fight My Monster (also eVenture). Counter-evidence: at the July 2012 rebrand TechCrunch wrote that BV had run 'five different funds worldwide - in the US, Europe, Asia, Russia, and South America' and that 'Eastern Europe ... will go by "e.ventures Russia"', each with a local team; no filing, register or press page names a Russia-only vehicle, so 'e.ventures Russia' reads as a desk brand investing from eVenture Fund I (and its successor European funds), not its own fund family.
